headline.caveat: $3B Humain investment in xAI's Series E (Feb 2026), paired with a 500MW Saudi data-center JV in which xAI is the anchor tenant/first customer (JV capitalization terms undisclosed).

realized_to_date.caveat: Series E investment funded; JV data-center capex contributions are separate and undisclosed (first phases under construction).

nature_md: Two-part sovereign tie-up: Humain invested $3B in xAI's ~$20B Series E (Jan-Feb 2026, at ~$230B pre-merger valuation, alongside Nvidia, Cisco, Valor, Fidelity, QIA, MGX), and the two are building a 500MW AI data center in Saudi Arabia — announced Nov 2025 with xAI as first customer — powered by Humain's NVIDIA GPU program. Circular by construction: Saudi capital funds xAI's equity while xAI's compute rental anchors the Saudi data center's revenue case.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Humain/PIF books the $3B as a strategic equity investment (no public accounts); JV data-center capex is capitalized in the JV. Returns depend on both xAI equity marks and DC utilization.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: xAI books equity financing — no revenue; its future payments as JV tenant will be compute opex flowing partly back to its own investor's infrastructure. Tenant commitments not disclosed.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** xAI gets sovereign-scale capital and Gulf inference capacity without US grid constraints; Humain gets a marquee anchor tenant that de-risks its buildout. **Bear:** investor-funds-tenant circularity in miniature — the same balance sheet sits on both sides of the future rent checks, and disclosure on the JV's actual capitalization is nil.
